missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Километр' stays in the nominative case as the subject of the clause. 'Последний' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'впереди' sets the position.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. As an inanimate masculine noun, 'километр' is identical in the accusative, here the object of 'пробежал'. 'Один' agrees in the masculine.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. After 'нет', the noun becomes genitive 'километра'. 'До города' uses the genitive after 'до', marking the distance.

missions.phrase: К каждому километру я устаю сильнее.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 'Километру' is the dative after 'к', here marking progression. 'Каждому' agrees in the masculine dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental with 'с'. 'Километром' is the instrumental after 'с' in the idiom meaning with every kilometre. 'Каждым' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О километре' uses the prepositional after 'о' to mark the topic. 'Первом' agrees in the masculine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural after a small number. 'Километра' is the count form used after 'три'. 'До финиша' uses the genitive after 'до'.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after a number. 'Километров' is the genitive plural required after 'десять'. The verb 'прошёл' shows the distance covered.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Километры' is the nominative plural subject of 'дались'. 'Эти' agrees, and 'тяжело' describes the difficulty.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after 'несколько'. 'Километров' is the genitive plural required after the quantifier 'несколько'. 'За' frames the covered span.
